title: The Philistines Return the Ark of the Lord
description: After the ark of the Lord had been among the Philistines for seven months, they sent it back to Israel on a new cart pulled by two cows that went straight toward Beth-shemesh, along with golden tumors and golden mice as a guilt offering. The people of Beth-shemesh received the ark during the wheat harvest and offered the cows as a burnt offering. [ref:1 Sam 6:1-18|1 Samuel 6:1-18]
